study: Polymarket's first live step, a read-only pre-study (2026-10-01): the reward universe's keyless aggregates, the power of an actual-to-formula reward ratio, and the bridge's quotes; and the live calibration's selection, timed end to end through the order path's own code (2026-10-01); and mid-pool's exclusion margin and its selection's CPU, measured through its own code (2026-10-02)
run: cd scripts && python3 ratio_power.py  # -> results/ratio_power_out.txt, identical on re-run (seed 20261001)
python3 scripts/reward_agg.py  # live, keyless; aggregates only, no per-market row written or printed
cd scripts && npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-net --allow-env selection_time.ts 3 6 120 > ../results/selection_time_out.txt  # live, keyless; scores only the [$6, $10) universe and names no market

prep_check.sql  # the live-prep pre-registration's check (reviews/2026-10-01-polymarket-live-prep-prereg.md): read-only, one statement, run once at or after 2026-10-03 00:10 UTC; its sha256 is pinned by src/pm_prep_prereg.test.js

prep_check_addendum1.sql  # the check of the pre-registration's Addendum 1 (Davies, 2026-10-01: the test starts now; the window opens on the first full UTC hour after 2026-10-01's selection and closes 2026-10-03 00:00 UTC): read-only, one statement, run once at or after 2026-10-03 00:10 UTC; its sha256 is pinned by src/pm_prep_prereg.test.js

cd scripts && npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-net --allow-env mid_margin.ts 14 > ../results/mid_margin_out.txt  # live, keyless, about 17 minutes; RW's selection recomputed by agents/pm_mid.ts rwSelectionNow, counts and ratios only, no market named

cd scripts && python3 cpu_time.py deno run --allow-net --allow-env mid_selection_time.ts 0 batch, then 3 batch and 3 single, each appended to ../results/mid_selection_time_out.txt  # live, keyless; Deno 1.46.3; mid-pool's selection through agents/pm_live.ts selectMarkets with its instance, its CPU read around each process

mid_check.sql, mid_readout.sql, mid_audit.sql  # the mid-pool pre-registration's day-1 check, fourteen-day readout and overlap audit (reviews/2026-10-02-polymarket-mid-pool-prereg.md): read-only, one statement each, run once at their dates; their sha256 are pinned by src/pm_mid_prereg.test.js
